changelog: Phase L103 hotfix #2 — location_id=0 was being rejected as invalid in getActiveTariff + syncLocationToControlPlane, causing every L103 gate to return fail-closed on tenants whose Database::activeLocationId() falls back to 0 (i.e. tenants with no rows in their locations table — the common case). Symptom: prod deploy with tariffs + subscriptions correctly seeded → cart/reservation still 402. Root cause: `if ($tenantId <= 0 || $locationId <= 0)` guard clause returned null before the SQL query ran; 0 is a valid placeholder for legacy/single-location tenants. Fix: relax to `$locationId < 0` in both methods. Also aligned backfill placeholder from location_id=1 to location_id=0 so it matches the activeLocationId() fallback. Zero migration required — existing subscription rows on location_id=0 will now resolve correctly.
